heaven.consequence: Absorption withdraws environmental qi. Reinforcement withdraws personal qi. Formations withdraw supplied or stored qi.
An unopened channel cannot deliver qi to a hand, leg, weapon or dantian.
A large reserve cannot pass instantly through a narrow wrist channel.
Conductivity, direction, gates and pressure differences determine actual movement.
Refinement, conversion, compression, reinforcement and permanent development consume energy or time.
Attributes, tempering grades, nutrition, injuries and equipment constrain execution.
More simultaneous branches, tighter timing and unfamiliar operations increase execution error.
Overpressure, unstable mixtures, lodged impurity and physical overload cause injury through shared rules.
Only the channels and tissues successfully exercised adapt.
A successful method on one body is evidence, not universal truth.
Bestowal grants instructions. It does not open channels, fill reserves or guarantee survival.
Rendering, call frequency and fast-forward never change authoritative outcomes.
